Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent French and access to our Paris office

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by allowing them to build better software, together. We're looking for an experienced Senior Solutions Engineer in the United States to provide technical presales support for our enterprise customer base — in regulated industries, particularly financial services and healthcare.   

 

Our Senior Solutions Engineers are responsible for the technical relationships with customers and prospects, working as a trusted advisor to remove technical objections and creatively address pain points in a customer's SDLC. They will work internally with sales and product development teams to identify solutions that meet customers' business needs and document requests to expand the capabilities of GitHub's platform.  

 

We're extremely passionate about the quality of our work. If you are technically sharp, business minded, and people oriented, you might be a fit for this role! 


Responsibilities

  • Identifying customer business & technical requirements and matching them to product solutions. 

  • Building joint customer strategies with enterprise sales, support, and customer success to encourage product adoption. 

  • Delivering live demonstrations of GitHub’s products and platform to prospective customers.  

  • Navigating complex technical scenarios to help customers migrate to GitHub from their existing development tools and workflows.  

  • Building relationships with key decision makers and serving as a customer's technical point of contact and advocate.  

  • Learning about customers' successes and challenges, sharing customer feedback within GitHub, and advocating for customer interests.  

  • Applying understanding of customer environment and goals to provide oversight and guide post-sales teams to successful outcomes. 


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience 
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience 
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 2+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience 
    • OR equivalent experience.

  • Experience owning all technical aspects of the sales cycle from discovery to qualification to proof-of-concept design/execution to post-sales transition.

  • Domain knowledge in one or more of the following: 

    • Source Control Management (SCM) including Git & GitHub workflows, and the value of DevOps & DevSecOps 

    • Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) architecture, tools and workflows 

    • DevSecOps, including software composition and security analysis, SAST/DAST tooling, and common patterns & industry trends 

    • Agentic software development practices and tools.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% when needed.

 

Additional or Preferred Qualifications:

  • 10+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience 
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience 
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience
    • OR equivalent experience.

  • 3+ years experience in digital transformation using software modernization to drive customer business outcomes.

  • Ability to identify and solve technical and business challenges related to software delivery.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with prior public speaking experience.

  • Demonstrable knowledge of the enterprise Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).  

  • Experience working in or with large enterprise development teams: in the regulated industries sector technical sales or solving regulated industry-specific software development, implementation or compliance challenges. 

 

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $90,580.00 - USD $240,310.00 /Yr.

In addition, this role also has the opportunity to earn sales incentives. On target earnings (OTE) is based on a 70/30 base salary/sales incentive.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.


We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

US Salary Range
$144,000—$192,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.

About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

As a Partner Development Manager, you will own the strategy, execution, and business outcomes for GitHub’s strategic and growth partners in the Corporate business. You will align GitHub, Microsoft, and partner priorities; build executive relationships; orchestrate cross-functional teams; and convert partner capabilities and investments into qualified pipeline, product consumption, customer adoption, and measurable growth. 


Responsibilities

Co-Sell Partnerships  

  • Build and lead a high impact partner portfolio by identifying the partners, capabilities, investments, and joint motions most likely to improve customer outcomes and accelerate GitHub growth. 

  • Facilitate strategic matchmaking between partners and sellers to support digital transformation initiatives.  

  • Integrate partner expertise into sales cycles to grow GitHub product consumption.  

  • Partner with the Technical Partner Manager to translate market opportunities and capability gaps into prioritized offers, technical development plans, services capacity, and go-to-market actions on the GitHub platform. Own business alignment and execution while ensuring technical readiness supports the agreed growth plan. 

  • Orchestrate segment aligned account teams, technical partner teams, marketing, skilling, and partner stakeholders against a shared plan; clarify ownership, resolve blockers, and maintain accountability for demand generation and customer value. 

  • Lead joint partner strategy, partner-to-partner collaboration, and co-sell-ready initiatives, and translate them into an executive-aligned Partner Business Plan with priorities, accountable owners, milestones, investments, risks, and measurable outcomes. 

  • Engage Microsoft partner, sales, technical, marketing, and leadership stakeholders to align each managed partner to the joint strategy, connect the right field resources, and accelerate execution against shared priorities. 

  • Manage co-selling with GitHub’s most strategic solution partners, driving joint pipeline development and consumption at scale.  

  • Guide account teams in selecting and engaging the right partner solutions based on customer needs, technical fit, delivery capability, and growth potential. 

  • Increase field awareness and adoption of partner solutions across priority industries, and measure impact through qualified pipeline, services attach, customer adoption, product consumption, and partner-influenced growth. 

Pipeline Development  

  • Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline across the portfolio, establishing coverage and quality standards, prioritizing high-impact opportunities, monitoring conversion and partner responsiveness, and driving corrective action when performance is off plan. 

  • Lead partner forecasting and territory planning, validate pipeline quality and timing, identify coverage and conversion gaps, and establish recovery actions with partners and GitHub sellers. 

  • Lead recurring pipeline reviews with priority partners and GitHub sellers to inspect progress, surface risks, make prioritization decisions, assign corrective actions, and track commitments through completion. 

Partner Performance and Impact  

  • Synthesize partner and customer feedback from direct engagement, surveys, events, and social listening; prioritize recurring blockers, assign accountable actions, escalate systemic issues, and close the loop with stakeholders. 

  • Builds partner led growth by standardizing adoption, security, platform, migration, and services offers; embedding partner attach early in priority account planning; identifying the right partner offer to the right field opportunity; and establishing joint seller ownership for services, adoption, and expansion outcomes. 

  • Adapt partner strategies to scale and complexity, aligning resources to accelerate co-sell velocity.  

  • Own partner performance scorecards and data quality across agreed KPIs. Analyze trends and variances, communicate decision-ready insights, and drive timely corrective actions when results are off plan. 

  • Lead forward-looking Quarterly Business Reviews with strategic partners and GitHub and Microsoft sales leaders to assess performance, surface risks and opportunities, secure executive decisions, and confirm accountable next actions. 

  • Provide actionable feedback to internal teams and support continuous improvement.  

  • Ensure compliance with GitHub’s sales policies and support the presentation of innovative partner solutions.  

  • Encourage partners to drive CSP opportunities through the GitHub field teams driving new logos, renewals, and value-added services, while supporting CSP outcomes.

Required Qualifications

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Sales, Marketing, Business Operations, Software Engineering, Business Administration, or related field AND 5+ years experience in core sales, channel sales, industry or solution selling, architecture experience, or business development experience
    • OR Master's Degree in Sales, Marketing, Business Operations, Software Engineering, Business Administration, or related field AND 3+ years experience in core sales, channel sales, industry or solution selling, architecture experience, or business development experience

  • Strong relationship building and deal structuring skills for both consumption and subscription-based software products
  • Executive level communication and presentation skills (both written and verbal), with the ability to mentor others
  • Experience in high-tech, Artificial Intelligence or software development industries

Description

Millions of fans stream live sports and events on Prime Video, from the Thursday Night Football, NBA Playoffs, NASCAR, MLB, MLS, and The Emmy's, to international soccer, cricket, and tennis. When a game is on, there is no second chance: if fans can't get into the stream or it cuts out at a key moment, we lose their trust. We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the programs that keep our live events available and high quality for every fan, on every device, every time. Our live event lineup grows by double digits every year, so our systems, processes and standards need to scale just as fast to keep every event reliable for fans.

You'll own how we define, measure and improve the live event experience across our own broadcasts and the ones we deliver with partners. You'll work with engineering, product, operations and partner teams to find the weak spots in our systems before game day, drive fixes that prevent repeat issues, and make sure our metrics reflect what fans actually experience. This role suits someone who is technically curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by work that customers notice right away.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the live event availability goal from start to finish: define what "available" means for fans, set targets, and report progress to senior leadership.

- Lead cross-team programs that close gaps in how we detect and measure issues during live event. Examples include fans who can't start a stream, get kicked out early or join late.

- Drive post-incident reviews and make sure the resulting fixes are actually delivered, so the same problem doesn't happen twice.

- Set and roll out operational standards for content partners, including pre-event checks, communication during major events and change deadlines, and help partners meet them.

- Partner with engineering on readiness for high-profile events: testing, monitoring, release controls and backup plans.

- Build clear reporting and dashboards that give leaders an honest view of quality and risk.

- Write clear narratives and plans that align teams and leaders on priorities, trade-offs and investments.

- Find recurring problems in incident data and turn them into long-term programs rather than one-off fixes.

A day in the life

Your morning might start with a review of last night's NBA doubleheader: what went well, what fans experienced, and whether anything needs a deeper look. Next you could meet with engineering leads about a gap in monitoring, then join a call with a content partner to walk through pre-event requirements ahead of a cricket tournament or a NASCAR weekend. In the afternoon you might refine a proposal for next year's quality goals or prepare a leadership update. On Thursday Night Football nights or during a live awards show, you'll work closely with operations and engineering teams to make sure everyone is ready, and you'll help lead the response if something goes wrong. No two days are the same. The live calendar runs from fall football to spring playoffs to summer racing and keeps the pace energizing, and your work shows up directly in the fan experience.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 3+ years of software development experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design

- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Senior Manager, Automation & Controls

Location: London (Hybrid)

STACK supports hybrid working, typically combining three office or site-based days per week, subject to business requirements.

Role Summary

As Senior Manager, Automation & Controls, you will provide specialist controls expertise across STACK Infrastructure's Data Centre construction portfolio, supporting the design, coordination, commissioning and delivery of BMS, EPMS and associated network infrastructure. Working closely with Construction, Commissioning, BMS, IT, server teams, consultants, general contractors and controls vendors, you will provide technical oversight throughout project delivery, helping ensure controls systems are coordinated, tested and implemented in line with STACK standards. The role will cover multiple project locations rather than a single site. Regular presence at construction sites will be required for key testing, reviews and meetings, so flexibility to travel between locations as project needs dictate is essential.

This role can be based from Milan, Oslo, London or Geneva

Key Responsibilities

• Provide controls SME support to Construction and other project delivery functions.

• Liaise with STACK BMS and IT teams to facilitate switch and firewall configuration for BMS/EPMS.

• Liaise with STACK server teams to facilitate virtual machine (VM) configuration for BMS/EPMS.

• Undertake high-level reviews of key controls-related design deliverables.

• Assist with the coordination and oversight of SFAT activities and review commissioning test scripts related to controls.

• Maintain a regular site presence during major testing activities, providing an additional layer of scrutiny of BMS/EPMS systems and SME support to the Commissioning team.

• Oversee the close-out of BMS, EPMS and network-related items within the commissioning IRL.

• Engage with the Commissioning Agent, general contractor and vendors to advise on BMS, EPMS and network infrastructure commissioning programmes.

• Contribute to the development and management of controls design standards and oversee their implementation across projects.

• Capture project feedback and lessons learned and feed appropriate updates into controls standards.

• Attend sites as required to conduct progress walks, participate in key meetings and observe controls vendor site acceptance testing.

• Support controls vendors in resolving potential blockers and support vendors with BMS, EPMS and network coordination as required.

• Support the onboarding of controls vendors in line with STACK frameworks.

What You'll Bring

• An HNC in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent relevant technical qualification.

• Experience of controls network and power redundancy design and control panel design.

• Experience writing Sequences of Operation (SoO) and technical specifications.

• Practical knowledge of PLC and SCADA programming.

• Experience with controls hardware and device selection.

• Experience in commissioning management, design management and portfolio management.

• Good knowledge of mechanical and electrical building services.

• Knowledge of open protocols and experience of systems integration.

• Strong communication, technical report writing and presentation skills.

• The ability to track progress and provide clear reporting across multiple projects and stakeholders.

• Flexibility and willingness to travel regularly between multiple project locations as required.

What will make you stand out

• A degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.

• A recognised project management certification.

What We Offer

• Work on critical digital infrastructure, supporting the development and operation of some of the world’s most advanced Data Centre environments.

• Build your career with STACK, gaining exposure to large-scale projects and opportunities to shape delivery across a fast-growing European platform.

• Competitive benefits aligned with our country-specific policies.

About STACK Infrastructure

STACK is a proven, trusted partner for the world’s most innovative companies, designing, developing and operating sustainable global digital infrastructure. Backed by an unmatched record of reliable delivery and development expertise, STACK brings speed, scale, certainty and responsibility to the demands of a rapidly evolving digital infrastructure landscape.

description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s engineering teams are building the AI, robotics, simulation, data, and systems foundations needed to deploy a generalisable AI Driver safely and at scale.

About AI Validation

The AI Validation team develops the strategies, evidence, metrics, and test systems that build confidence in the Wayve AI Driver. Both locations translate ambiguous product and safety questions into validation plans, scenarios, metrics, coverage, acceptance criteria, and evidence for release decisions—but the product scope and candidate profile differ by location.

This role focuses primarily on ADAS and L2 autonomy functions. It works closely with automotive and OEM expectations, including product, customer, safety, and regulatory requirements. The role can be hired as a TC4 individual contributor or an M4 manager with responsibility for technical direction and team delivery.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Translate product, systems, and safety requirements into validation strategies, test scenarios, metrics, coverage requirements, and acceptance criteria.

  • Work hands-on with Python, evaluation pipelines, test implementation, simulation, and data analysis.

  • Analyse results and communicate findings, risks, and evidence to Product, Safety, Release, and Autonomy Engineering stakeholders.

  • Coordinate data, simulation, and evaluation dependencies so validation can run reliably and at scale.

  • Develop comprehensive verification strategies for ADAS and L2 autonomy functions.

  • Translate customer, OEM, safety, and regulatory expectations into practical validation evidence.

  • Build test suites spanning simulation and physical testing environments.

  • At M4, provide people leadership and coordinate validation delivery across the team; at TC4, provide senior technical ownership as an individual contributor.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • ADAS functions such as lane keeping and other assisted-driving capabilities.

  • Validation strategies aligned with automotive OEM development, customer expectations, SOTIF, and emerging AV-industry standards.

  • Simulated and physical test environments, comprehensive coverage, and evidence-based release decisions.

  • Python-based evaluation tooling, SQL and scalable data analysis, behavioural metrics, test coverage, and automated validation execution.

🙌 You should apply if

  • You understand how automotive companies and OEMs develop and validate ADAS or L2 autonomy products.

  • You can translate customer, safety, regulatory, and product expectations into structured validation strategies.

  • You have hands-on experience building scenarios, metrics, test suites, evaluation pipelines, or data-analysis workflows.

  • You can use Python professionally and are comfortable with SQL or similar large-scale analysis tools.

  • You have validated complex systems in simulation, the real world, or both.

  • You communicate clearly, document decisions well, and can own ambiguous problems from concept through evidence and recommendation.

  • ML, computer vision, motion planning, SOTIF, safety validation, or modern AI-tooling experience is advantageous.

  • For the M4 scope, you have experience leading people or coordinating a validation function; for TC4, you bring strong senior individual-contributor ownership.


🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2+ through to L4.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working

This role is based in London. We operate a hybrid model combining in-person collaboration in our offices and workshops with focused time working remotely.

🔍 The Interview Process

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (25 min)

  • Hiring Manager Screen (60 min)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews covering systems and domain expertise (4 hours)

  • Final interview focused on mission and values alignment (60 min)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (location dependent)

  • 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

  • 📈 Meaningful equity

  • ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

  • ✅ Hybrid working and hands-on access to workshops and labs

  • 📚 Learning and development support

  • 🩺 Comprehensive location-dependent health, family, retirement, and wellbeing benefits

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

Description

The Energy Analytics, Technical Program Manager (TPM) will scale power monitoring, insight generation, and energy and carbon reduction initiatives across Amazon's North America fulfillment operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will deploy and generate analysis from power metering infrastructure and implement load flexibility and energy optimization roadmaps that deliver measurable cost savings and carbon reductions. This work directly supports Amazon's demand-side power requirements and Climate Pledge commitments.

You will operate as an individual contributor, owning the delivery of defined and ambiguous work-streams while partnering with engineering, controls, data, operations and deployment teams to implement changes. You will influence cross-functional partners without authority, primarily at the team and management level, using data to drive decisions. You will integrate and analyze power metering information, providing load forecasts and generating cost and energy savings opportunities. Utility rate structures, time of day, demand ratchets and power factor penalties will influence your strategies. Technical assets influenced can include material handling, robotics, powered industrial trucks, lighting, heating ventilation and air conditioning, plug loads, electrical metering and more. Developed projects will be scaled across hundreds of facilities across the network, producing energy, cost and carbon benefit.

Key job responsibilities

● Build and execute technical solutions for energy and carbon reduction from pilot, data collection, through scaled implementation and measurement & verification (M&V) of results.  Energy and load optimization via control systems is a technical requirement: energy-conservation/standby modes, variable speed applications, and equipment scheduling.

● Drive continuous monitoring and energy efficiency improvements with Amazon's energy consuming assets.  Integrate power metering into our data sets, and develop analytics to identify opportunities, assess trending consumption changes, and measure benefits of conservation efforts.

● Prepare written analysis of feasibility studies and recommendations for various energy monitoring and power flexibility strategies.  Own metering data quality programs, check readings for completeness, outliers, and flag actionable improvements, and reconcile against known loads to ensure trusted insight generation.

● Develop metrics, baselines, and roadmaps that translate technical work into quantified outcomes (energy savings, cost savings or utility tariff arbitrage, load forecast, reliability, carbon reduction).

● Define and own technical approach and cross-system architecture for data configuration, standards and mechanisms for scalability and enforcement of key energy savings mechanisms. Decide how to build and prove new approaches managing tradeoffs for necessary business needs, rather than executing a defined scope.

● Manage projects against plans and objectives to ensure commitments are met, delivering against our power and Climate Pledge goals.

● Deep diving (troubleshooting) and unblocking issues that are prohibiting teams from pursuing energy reduction initiatives.

● Work with critical stakeholders on developing mechanisms for design standard integration for launching facilities that incorporate energy optimization procedures from Day 1.

● Analyze and communicate the financial impact of projects and initiatives (payback, return on investment, net present value)

● Serve as a technical reviewer for peers and partner engineers — reviewing control logic, metering architecture, and design-standard changes, and improving them on technical merit

● Quantify and own value add of energy savings mechanisms and how they reduce equipment runtime and increases reliability and lifespan.

● Calculate and report energy, water and carbon savings using International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol methodologies.

● Manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously.

● Produce clear documentation, playbooks, and reporting that make work-streams repeatable.

A day in the life

You might spend the morning querying newly integrated power-metering data and validating it against the distribution-panel hierarchy — resolving a data-quality gap — then analyzing load profiles and build an energy-savings or peak-shaving model that quantifies the opportunity by equipment class. You then define network rollout suitability and prioritize these opportunities across sites. In the afternoon you develop control logic changes to implement an efficiency opportunity, propose updates to a design standard, or define a measurement method for implemented energy and cost savings to your stakeholders. You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries.

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility

Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic recommendations

Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

About the team

The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience

- Experience working in a program management capacity and/or leading large-scale complex projects

- Experience providing and effectively communicating strategic and tactical recommendations based on data

- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

- MBA, or Advanced degree

- Experience in energy, power generation, or data center infrastructure

- Familiarity with nuclear energy development, permitting, or procurement processes

- Experience in organizational planning, headcount modeling, or operational controllership

Technical Infrastructure Program Manager - Network Fiber Builds, Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development

Job ID: 10566894 | Amazon Data Services, Inc.

Apply now

Description

Application deadline: Nov 26, 2026

Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. The AWS Cloud infrastructure is built around Regions and Availability Zones. AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. These Availability Zones give AWS customers an easier and more effective way to design and operate applications and databases, and they make those systems more highly available, fault tolerant, and scalable than traditional single data center or multi data center infrastructures. Would you like to join the team that plans and delivers the network builds behind that low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant network?

Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development (GCID) runs a Delivery function that owns the end to end delivery picture across our telecommunication network infrastructure programs. We are looking for a technically strong Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to run a portfolio of network builds from planning through completion. You will prioritize work based on customer needs and target dates, make sure deliverables come together across teams, and build integrated delivery plans that carry each build to handover.

You will hold the single, trusted view of delivery status across the program, form a clear position on risk and priority, and recommend decisions to leadership. You will own a portfolio of builds, bring teams to one shared view of status, and drive the prioritization decisions and trade-offs that keep delivery on track. You will give confident, data-backed updates to senior leaders and partner across many teams to move work forward.

You work well in ambiguity. You set up structure, standardize what you can, and improve the process as you go. You communicate clearly in writing and in person, and you hold a portfolio view rather than get pulled into managing every task. If you want to shape how a global infrastructure program delivers, we would like to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities

- Own portfolio management across the program, prioritizing builds and reporting integrated status to leadership

- Drive the implementation of large-scale telecommunication infrastructure deployments on a global scale

- Collaborate with stakeholder teams to gather telecommunication infrastructure deployment requirements

- Develop and maintain process documentation

- Program manage from intake, engineering, business development, material acquisition, deployment, and closeout

- Provide deployment support for projects, augmenting the local region TIPM across the globe

- Create and maintain performance dashboards and KPIs to measure program effectiveness

- Drive process improvements through data analysis and stakeholder feedback

- Lead regular executive updates and cross-functional team communications

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience

- 5+ years of working cross functionally across several teams experience, or a MBA and 5+ years of program or project management experience

- Experience leading and interacting with cross-functional teams

- Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)

- Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds

- 5+ years of technical infrastructure or program management experience for data center or telecommunications infrastructure

- Excellence in stakeholder management and executive communication

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil Engineering, or a similar technical discipline

- Experience with Kaizen and Continuous Improvement Process

- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

- Experience with supplier or vendor relationship management

- Strong understanding of fiber optic and pre-terminated fiber design, construction, and Outside Plant installation

- Knowledge of civil and telecom design requirements for data centers

- Experience developing program KPIs and performance dashboards (PowerBI, Tableau, or QuickSight)

- Proficiency in Salesforce, GIS platforms, and data visualization tools

Sr TPM, Perception, Prime Air Vehicle Software

Job ID: 10545552 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now

Description

Come work on the Amazon Prime Air Perception Team!

The Prime Air team is seeking a Sr Technical Program Manager (TPM) with a strong results-oriented focus to own and drive the development of our autonomous perception systems. This role will lead programs that expand our operational envelope into challenging conditions like night operations, adverse weather (rain, snow), and complex environments, while simultaneously driving algorithmic efficiency improvements across our perception stack.

You will work with teams across Seattle and Europe to: 

- Drive the technical roadmap for perception capabilities that enable safe autonomous flight in expanding operational conditions

- Lead cross-functional programs to optimize perception algorithms for improved efficiency and reduced computational overhead

- Coordinate integration of new perception capabilities with broader autonomy systems

- Partner with research teams to evaluate and implement computer vision and machine learning approaches

- Drive certification efforts for perception systems in accordance with aviation safety standards

- Manage technical dependencies and alignment across international engineering teams

Key job responsibilities

- Define and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs, including mission, vision, objectives, success criteria, and resource planning across multiple teams.

- Drive alignment between business and technical stakeholders by facilitating crisp decision-making, setting priorities, and communicating context for technology choices and trade-offs.

- Identify and mitigate risks proactively by analyzing system architectures, understanding dependencies and boundary conditions, and closing gaps in requirements, testing, and cross-team collaboration.

- Establish and maintain program metrics, regularly reviewing data to ensure visibility into progress, surface issues early, and keep initiatives aligned with organizational goals.

- Author and present narratives and program documents to senior leadership, translating complex technical topics into clear recommendations and actionable plans.

About the team

The Perception team is at the heart of Amazon's autonomous drone delivery initiative, developing the advanced computer vision and machine learning systems that enable safe, reliable flight operations. Our team tackles fascinating challenges at the intersection of radar technology, distributed computing, and real-time detection algorithms, creating solutions that have never been built before. We work in an innovative, collaborative environment where every scientists and engineer's contribution directly impacts the future of delivery technology. As we scale Amazon's drone delivery to new locations, you'll help shape both the technical direction and team culture that will define this transformative service for years to come.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 3+ years of software development experience

- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Technical Infrastructure Program Manager II, OneMHS

Job ID: 10553864 | Amazon.com Services LLC - A57

Apply now

Description

One Material Handling System (OMHS) is building Amazon's in-house material handling capabilities, transforming how Amazon designs, builds, and operates its facilities. As Amazon's internal material handling system integrator, we combine precision in technical project management with the vision needed to revolutionize our material handling capabilities. We are seeking a talented and motivated Technical Infrastructure Program Manager who will exemplify ownership of their assigned material handling projects, ensuring successful implementation across Amazon's network. Our TIPM works closely with WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, and cross-functional teams to deliver complex material handling systems. This role requires both strategic vision and tactical execution to standardize project delivery while maintaining the high standards that complex material handling systems demand. You will drive projects through our comprehensive Project Lifecycle Framework, from initiation through commissioning and handover, while helping establish the processes and playbooks that will enable OMHS to scale across Amazon's network.

Key job responsibilities

In partnership with WWDE, Operations Engineering, strategic suppliers, and other functional groups this individual will drive the execution strategy and management for material handling system implementations. This position will provide project leadership throughout the entire lifecycle of specific project(s) of a particular building type (ARS, SSD, AMZL, IXD, 1DC, RDC). 

- Serve as the single-threaded leader for material handling system implementation programs, driving end-to-end execution across mechanical engineering, controls integration, power systems, and operational requirements for specific building types (ARS, SSD, AMZL, IXD). 

- Lead a multi-disciplined team and sub-contractors; manage conflict, establish priorities, coordinate concurrent and sequencing activities, develop team members, and provide overall project leadership. 

- Manage the project master schedule, administrative, contractual, technical, and financial aspects of projects to achieve timely completion, holding all internal teams and external vendors accountable for their commitments. 

- Drive cross-functional communications and strategic planning for material handling system deployment, determining KPIs and driving standardization initiatives while building strong relationships with operations, functional groups, vendors, and senior leaders. 

- Define and continuously improve technical standards, deployment methodologies, and best practices for material handling system implementations, including the development of the Project Lifecycle Framework and implementation playbooks. 

- Coordinate across specialized engineering disciplines (mechanical, electrical, controls) to maintain ownership of system integration approaches, ensuring technical requirements, performance standards, and operational metrics are met throughout all lifecycle phases. 

- Manage technical partnerships with OEMs and 3P engineering firms to ensure optimal system design, integration, and commissioning. 

- Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks in system design, integration approach, and operational implementation while leveraging knowledge management systems and engineering documentation standards. 

- Drive commercial and technical strategy during project execution, creating mechanisms and processes that increase velocity while maintaining quality and execution excellence 

A day in the life

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to execute material handling system implementations while establishing standardized processes for future deployments. Provide cross-functional leadership by aligning engineering, operations, procurement, installation and commissioning teams around shared project objectives and milestones. Develop and deliver project execution strategies and detailed plans to drive implementation from initiation through commissioning, ensuring project(s) success. Own and manage project budgets, tracking expenditures against forecasts, identifying cost risks early, and implementing corrective actions to maintain financial targets. Maintain rigorous schedule oversight by developing comprehensive project timelines, monitoring critical path activities, and proactively addressing delays to keep projects on track. Interface with strategic partners to ensure successful integration of Amazon-spec equipment and facilitate cross-organizational collaboration to resolve technical and logistical challenges.

About the team

Our team is responsible for building and scaling Amazon's in-house material handling capabilities. We act as the internal system integrator, bringing together engineering, operations, and strategic suppliers to deliver infrastructure that powers Amazon's fulfillment network. We are a collaborative group that values clear communication, structured execution, and continuous improvement. As we grow, there are opportunities to take on larger programs, contribute to long-term strategy, and help shape how our team operates at scale.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in contract management

- Travel up to 50% of the time

- Minimum 3 years of Project Management experience demonstrating increasing levels of project value and complexity. Inclusive of experience leading projects across multiple stakeholders

- Experience with completion of medium sized projects (up to $40M) in the Construction and/or Material Handling Industry.

- Must be willing and able to travel up to 50% (Note: Most travel is done on weekdays)

Preferred Qualifications

- PMP, or PMP certificate

- Experience managing multiple internal stakeholders and advising cross-functional teams

- Experience with Automated Control System and material handing systems

- Master’s degree in project management, engineering or related field

Manager, Technical Infrastructure Program Management, Data Center Planning & Delivery

Job ID: 10519864 | Amazon Data Services, Inc.

Apply now

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of technical program managers, design engineers, construction managers, network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We're seeking an experienced Manager, Technical Infrastructure Program Management in Herndon, VA or Seattle, WA to lead a team of Technical Infrastructure Program Managers responsible for delivering data center build projects. In this role, you will manage, mentor, and develop a team of TIPMs while maintaining direct ownership of program delivery. You will lead cross-functional and technical teams from conceptual design feasibility through scope and schedule creation, budget management, completed design, implementation, commissioning, and data center deployment. Along the way, you will use your judgment, critical thinking skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent, technical aptitude, and leadership to collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders, eliminate non-value-add activities, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery.

The successful candidate will be a strong communicator (both written and verbal), not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities, and be capable of understanding mechanical/electrical engineering concepts. They will have demonstrated experience building, developing, and leading high-performing teams. They will be able to apply a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Other requirements include experience with MS Office, MS Project and MS SharePoint. Experience with Tableau, KanBan, Playbook, SQL and systems integration a plus.

Key job responsibilities

We are seeking a Manager, Technical Infrastructure Program Management to lead a team and deliver on end-to-end builds. You will be responsible for hiring, developing, and retaining top talent on your team while working with stakeholder teams to map dependencies, create and drive schedules, and think big to solve some of our biggest challenges. You will set the vision and direction for your team, coach and develop program managers at various career stages, manage performance, and remove barriers to your team's success. We're looking for a people leader who is highly organized, has strong attention to detail, and brings a problem-solving mindset with the ability to dive deep into critical path items. This is a high-judgment role to develop talent and deliver capacity to our end customers.

About the team

*Why AWS* Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences* Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance* We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture* Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth* We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, Economics or other related fields

- 7+ years of project management (including scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk and critical path management) experience

- 3+ years of team management experience

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of team management experience

- Experience working in a data center or mission critical facility (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.), or experience in construction

- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
