title: Customer Success Manager - EMEA
description:
Company Overview:

TENEX is an AI-native, automation-first, built-for-scale Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider. We are a force multiplier for defenders, helping organizations enhance their cybersecurity posture through advanced threat detection, rapid response, and continuous protection. Our team is composed of industry experts with deep experience in cybersecurity, automation and AI-driven solutions. Backed by leading investors, we are rapidly growing and seeking top talent to join our mission of revolutionizing the AI-Native MDR landscape.

We’re a fast growing startup backed by industry experts and top tier investors led by Crosspoint Capital Partners and also backed by Shield Capital, DTCP (formerly Deutsche Telekom Capital Partners), Deepwork Capital, and the Florida Opportunity Fund. Seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As an early employee, you’ll play a meaningful role in defining and building our culture. Get in on the ground floor. We’re a small but well-funded team that just raised a substantial round – joining now comes with limited risk and unlimited upside

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at TENEX, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring our customers achieve their security goals and derive maximum value from our platform and services. You will be the primary advocate for our customers, driving adoption, satisfaction, and long-term success.

Culture is one of the most important things at TENEX.AI—explore our culture deck at culture.tenex.ai to witness how we embody it, prioritizing the irreplaceable collaboration and community of in-person work.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers, ensuring they fully leverage TENEX’s MDR platform to meet their cybersecurity needs.

  • Own the customer relationship post-sale, driving engagement, retention, and expansion opportunities.

  • Develop and execute customer success plans, ensuring smooth onboarding and continued adoption of TENEX’s services.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer, providing feedback to internal teams to drive continuous product and service improvements.

  • Conduct regular business reviews with customers to assess security posture, provide insights, and align on future goals.

  • Proactively identify risks and implement strategies to mitigate churn, ensuring high customer satisfaction.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Security Operations teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

  • Educate customers on best practices, new features, and enhancements to maximize their security outcomes.

  • Track and analyze customer usage data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

  • Facilitate contract renewals and support expansion efforts in partnership with the Sales team.

  • Travel as needed (10-15%) to meet with key customers and strengthen relationships.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Technical & Industry Expertise

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related role in cybersecurity, SaaS, or MDR services.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat detection, and incident response.

  • Familiarity with SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or other security technologies is a plus.

Customer-Focused Skills

  • Proven ability to manage customer relationships, drive adoption, and ensure customer satisfaction.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to identify customer pain points and deliver solutions.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex security concepts in an easy-to-understand manner.

description:
We're looking for a Technical Program Manager with strong Product thinking to drive inline's Table Management System (TMS) and Food Ordering (FO) products, together with our global partner integrations.
The right person in this role will play a pivotal role in planning, building, and scaling the products that power restaurants' front-of-house operations — reservations, table management, queuing, deposits & payments, and food ordering — while connecting inline to a growing ecosystem of global partners such as booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls, and regional restaurant groups. The key to this role is orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder programs that serve merchants, patrons, and partners at once, and turning deep F&B domain knowledge into product decisions that improve merchant operations and patron experiences across markets.
Responsibilities

Strategy & Prioritization

Partner closely with the stakeholders and UX design team to shape and translate product vision into executable roadmaps for the TMS and FO product lines.

Conduct market research and competitive analysis across the F&B tech landscape (reservation platforms, POS ecosystems, food ordering, channel managers) to provide product recommendations.

Evaluate product and integration opportunities by balancing merchant value, patron experience, partner impact, engineering effort, and operational complexity.

Continuously monitor product and partner metrics (e.g. partner-driven bookings, seated conversion, no-show rate) and provide insights to refine priorities and roadmap execution.

Program Management

Lead cross-functional programs from planning through execution across the TMS and FO product surfaces, including different interfaces for both restaurants and patrons, and premium add-on features.

Coordinate closely with Engineering, Design, QA, CSM/BD, Marketing, Operations, and other stakeholders to align priorities and execution.

Manage Product Backlog, Release Planning, Sprint Planning, and Scrum execution.

Identify project risks, resolve blockers proactively, and drive teams toward successful delivery, including launch readiness such as internal playbooks and training.

Global Partner Integration

Own the end-to-end partner integration lifecycle: scoping and scenario design, API documentation and testing setup, kickoff, development support, E2E testing, launch, and post-launch operations.

Manage integrations across partner types — booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls and hospitality groups, and regional restaurant groups.

Serve as the primary technical counterpart for global partners across regions and time zones, running kickoff meetings, joint testing, and ongoing technical communication.

Define integration scenarios, acceptance criteria, and success metrics; keep integration projects transparent and on track for internal and external stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management & F&B Insights

Manage intensive, ongoing communication across internal stakeholders (leadership, Engineering, Design, QA, Go to Market teams with daily interaction, Marketing) and external stakeholders (partners and key merchant accounts) with often-competing priorities.

Develop a deep understanding of restaurant front-of-house operations: reservations as inventory management and capacity planning, reservations as a key patron touchpoint, table management, queuing, no-show and revenue assurance/deposit policies, and online food ordering workflows — and represent the merchant's voices in product decisions.

Translate merchant and partner feedback into clear pain point statements and roadmap inputs.

Support multinational delivery with customers in seven highly differentiated markets, including localization and market-specific requirements across regions such as TW, HK, JP, SEA, and ANZ.

 

Requirements

Required

5+ years of Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management, or related experience.

Experience building B2B or B2B2C SaaS software ; vertical SaaS for F&B, restaurants, or hospitality is a strong plus.

Deep F&B industry knowledge, especially restaurant front-of-house operations: reservation and table management, queuing, deposits/no-show handling, POS, or food ordering.

Hands-on experience with adding new third-party integrations And expanding upon existing third-party Integrations — REST APIs, Webhooks, API key/staging environment management, data licensing compliance automation, and end-to-end testing with external partner engineering teams.

Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving alignment across executives, cross-functional teams, and external partners.

Ability to work closely with Engineering to evaluate technical feasibility, development effort, and resource planning.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Excellent cross-functional communication and program management skills; able to work in English with global partners.

 

Preferred

Experience working directly with engineers designers in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:

Online payment systems, including payment gateways (e.g. Stripe, TapPay), digital wallets (Apple Pay, AliPay, WeChat Pay), deposits/prepayment flows, or subscription billing.

Omnichannel messaging or Omnichannel CRM systems (e.g. Intercom, Twilio Flex, Zendesk, etc)

Global Distribution Systems (GDS) used by airlines or hotels to create and manage priced booking inventory that is published to OTA services (e.g. Amadeus, Travelport, Sabre, or Siteminder, Opera, Cendyn, Shiji, etc)

Booking channel integrations, such as Reserve with Google, channel managers, or OTA/booking platform ecosystems.

POS or hospitality tech ecosystems, including KDS, kiosk, or in-store hardware-adjacent products.

Multi-market product delivery, including multi-language support and market-specific compliance or operational requirements.

Experience working with Product Analytics and data-driven prioritization.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Feature Owner Team

Wayve’s Product & Delivery team turns our AI Driver technology into valuable, scalable vehicle capabilities for global OEM partners. We work at the intersection of customer needs, product strategy and engineering delivery—defining what great looks like, aligning teams around a clear outcome and ensuring that Wayve’s technology can be brought to market safely and effectively.

As part of this team, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of specific Collision Avoidance and Lane Keeping ADAS functionalities. You’ll work closely with OEM customers, product and engineering teams to define feature scope, set performance targets and guide delivery from concept through to production. Your work will directly shape how Wayve’s technology performs for customers and drivers as we progress towards higher levels of autonomy.

  • Act as the accountable product owner for specific ADAS features, ensuring they are delivered on time, to the agreed specification and in line with customer and business needs.

  • Partner closely with OEM customers to understand their requirements, represent their needs internally and align expectations without compromising Wayve’s product strategy.

  • Work with feature group owners and engineering teams to define feature scope, specifications, performance targets and delivery plans.

  • Engage throughout feature development, providing early feedback, participating in testing and supporting evaluation and validation activities.

  • Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of ADAS features across Collision Avoidance and Lane Keeping, including Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB), Lane Keeping Assist (LKA), Evasive Steering Assist (ESA), Automatic Emergency Steering (AES) and Blind Spot Monitoring (BSM).

  • Defining and evolving feature specifications in partnership with OEMs, engineering and product teams.

  • Harmonising customer requirements across OEM partners to maximise reusable assets, scalability and efficient feature delivery.

  • Setting clear performance targets and ensuring features meet customer requirements, internal capabilities and agreed delivery specifications.

  • Supporting testing, evaluation and validation to ensure feature quality and readiness for production.

  • Maintaining and evolving the strategic feature roadmap as Wayve’s technology advances towards higher levels of autonomy.

  • Participating in agile planning and delivery rituals, helping teams manage dependencies, risks and priorities effectively.

  • Ensuring feature delivery aligns with relevant automotive quality, safety and compliance expectations.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have strong experience specifying and delivering ADAS features from concept through to production, particularly across Collision Avoidance or Lane Keeping functions such as AEB, LKA, ESA, AES or BSM.

  • You understand automotive development processes, including requirements management, the V-model, ASPICE, quality and validation.

  • You are confident working directly with OEM customers: understanding their needs, negotiating requirements and representing their perspective internally while maintaining a clear view of Wayve’s product strategy.

  • You have sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with engineering teams on feature trade-offs, feasibility, testing, evaluation and validation.

  • You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can bridge technical and commercial perspectives, creating alignment across customers, product and engineering teams.

  • You proactively identify risks and issues before they escalate, balancing immediate delivery needs with the longer-term product roadmap.

  • You are comfortable in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and can bring structure and clarity without adding unnecessary process.

  • Experience shipping complete ADAS features into large-scale automotive production programmes would be valuable.

  • Knowledge of automotive quality, safety and compliance standards—including ASPICE, SOTIF, functional safety, GSR-II and DCAS—would be valuable.

  • Experience with machine learning, LLMs or recent generative-AI methods and architectures would be beneficial.

  • You bring curiosity and a forward-looking approach to developing new ADAS capabilities and advancing the customer experience.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our Leonberg office. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces and workshops with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

title: Cross-Functional Mechanical Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


We want you as a Cross-Functional Mechanical Engineer to bring hands-on structural design experience and sound engineering judgement to the mechanical development and verification of Nyx. With a strong system-level mindset, you will support subsystem teams in developing robust designs, resolving mechanical challenges, and substantiating the integrity of critical hardware throughout the development lifecycle.

A key focus of your role will be to develop and consolidate the mechanical justifications supporting NASA requirements compliance and Safety Review Panel (SRP) activities. Working with subsystem owners and the safety and certification teams, you will establish the technical basis for allowable damage and failure criteria across critical vehicle components. You will combine direct technical contributions with practical guidance to engineers and suppliers, connecting component-level assessments with vehicle-level requirements and safety considerations.

You will be part of the Nyx Design Office Team, within the Cross-Functional Mechanical team, and will report to the Integrated Mechanical Sizing & Assurance Team Leader.


Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Integration

  • Provide hands-on structural design expertise and technical guidance across subsystems, supporting mechanical integrity and consistency at vehicle level.

  • Assess load paths, interfaces, stiffness, and boundary conditions to understand how mechanical, pressure, and thermo-mechanical loads are transferred through components, attachments, and the vehicle structure.

  • Perform and review mechanical assessments using engineering calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), and test evidence, challenging assumptions and identifying the failure modes that drive design decisions.

  • Support subsystem owners in translating high-level mechanical requirements into subsystem and component specifications, maintaining traceability and accounting for vehicle-level interactions.

Compliance & Verification

  • Develop and document mechanical justifications for allowable damage and failure criteria for critical Nyx hardware, in collaboration with the relevant subsystem and discipline specialists.

  • Establish the supporting rationale through analysis and test evidence, addressing relevant strength, stability, fatigue, fracture, damage tolerance, and residual performance considerations as applicable to each component.

  • Support NASA SRP activities by preparing mechanical justification, contributing to compliance matrices and verification evidence, and addressing technical questions and review actions with the safety and certification teams.

  • Review qualification strategies, test plans, and reports for consistency with applicable NASA requirements, agreed standards, and the assumptions used in mechanical analyses.

  • Participate in design reviews, identify gaps in mechanical justification, and recommend design changes or additional verification activities to resolve them.

Supplier Interactions and Team Collaboration

  • Review supplier designs, structural analyses, and verification documentation to assess technical maturity and consistency with subsystem and vehicle requirements at key milestones.

  • Provide practical technical guidance to suppliers and subsystem owners, resolving mechanical issues and following technical actions through to closure.

  • Facilitate technical alignment between subsystem teams, structural analysis, materials and processes, testing, safety and certification, and suppliers, ensuring that assumptions, interfaces, and responsibilities are clearly understood.

What We Would Love to See from You

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant practical experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical or structural engineering within the aerospace or aeronautics industry.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and justifying structural or mechanical hardware through development and qualification, in aerospace or aeronautics.

  • Experience assessing relevant failure mechanisms and developing defensible mechanical justifications, including damage acceptance or failure criteria for safety-critical hardware.

  • Ability to perform and critically review engineering calculations and FEA, interpret CAD models and engineering drawings, and relate analysis assumptions to the physical design and test configuration.

  • Understanding of mechanical requirements flow-down, qualification and verification processes, and traceable compliance evidence, together with familiarity with applicable space standards and NASA requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to guide engineers and suppliers through complex mechanical problems while considering subsystem interfaces and vehicle-level consequences.

Additional experience we would value:

  • Direct involvement in NASA safety reviews or SRP submissions, particularly the preparation and defence of mechanical qualification and the closure of review actions.

  • Experience with pressurized structures, fluid piping, radiators, or propulsion hardware, and with fracture control, damage tolerance, or structural test campaigns.

Skills and Behaviors:

  • System-Level Thinking: Ability to connect component-level design and failure mechanisms with subsystem interfaces, vehicle performance, and safety objectives.

  • Engineering Judgement: Ability to identify governing load paths and failure modes, challenge modelling assumptions, and distinguish between a numerical result and a sound mechanical justification.

  • Influence & Decision-Making: Ability to guide technical decisions across teams and suppliers through clear reasoning and evidence, while working within agreed technical responsibilities.

  • Mentorship: Ability to share practical design experience and help engineers strengthen their structural understanding and verification practices.

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to work constructively with internal teams, suppliers, and external reviewers, including NASA, in coordination with the safety and certification teams.

  • Problem-Solving: Proactive in identifying mechanical risks, prioritizing substantiation gaps, and developing proportionate solutions that protect technical integrity and program objectives.

  • Communication: Clear and structured communicator, able to explain assumptions, load paths, failure criteria, and supporting evidence to different technical audiences.

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Competence, Integrity and Passion.

  • Fluent in English. Knowledge of German, French and Italian is an asset.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an AI Deployment Strategist you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral’s AI models, working closely with customers from strategic vision through production implementation.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, business strategy, and hands-on deployment. Specializing in robotics, you will help customers connect Mistral’s models with robotic systems, operational workflows, and existing technical infrastructure.

You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps for robotics, collaborate with Mistral’s technical teams to deliver production solutions, and ensure smooth transitions from pre-sales to post-sales; with a focus on large enterprises. Your job is to understand modern robotics systems well enough, including their capabilities, constraints, and deployment realities and link them to customers hardest challenges and guide them and our technical teams to successful outcomes.

Where robotics stands at Mistral today: we focus on delivering the best robotics models on the field, going beyond research to unlock concrete ROI. We work on the intelligence layer only. We integrate with incumbent robot platforms, we do not build robots. We work through research partnerships and pilots with industrial customers, not an off the shelf product. . We customise our models with manufacturers on their own floor via data capture and fine-tuning to reach best scalable results.

This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast paced environment, enjoy solving complex technical challenges in robotics, and are passionate about turning AI science into real world impact. You will be based in Paris, co-located with the science team and our robotics lab, working closely with our Singapore hub, and traveling 30-60%.

What You Will Do

Strategic discovery and vision setting

  • Lead executive level workshops to identify robotics specific business challenges and opportunities where Mistral’s AI can drive step change improvements for industrial manufacturing.

  • Translate customer priorities into practical robotics use cases across areas such as industrial automation, manipulation, inspection, navigation, and human–robot interaction.

  • Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the “art of the possible” and a clear path to value. Define a progression from initial experimentation to deployment in real operating environments.

  • Partner with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify ROI, and align solutions with customer objectives.

  • Help customers prioritize robotics use cases based on value, feasibility, data availability, operational readiness, and deployment risk.

AI and robotics solution deployment

  • Architect an end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral’s models and platform into customer manufacturing workflows and technical infrastructure.

  • Determine how these solutions should interact with customers’ robotic systems, software, data pipelines, and operational processes.

  • Partner with the Applied AI and Science teams to design, prototype, and deploy roboticssolutions in production, ensuring scalability and impact.

  • Own pilots and proofs of value, demonstrating the technology’s potential and paving the way for full-scale deployments.

  • Guide deployment at scale on diverse infrastructure (on-premise, edge, cloud) to ensure that proposed solutions account for real world constraints such as latency, reliability, safety, connectivity, hardware limitations, and changing operating conditions.

Value realization and customer success

  • Serve as a trusted advisor, guiding customer robotics strategy and ensuring maximum value from Mistral’s solutions.

  • Monitor and communicate outcome-driven KPIs, on both science hypothesis and business impact, with executive sponsors.

  • Identify and address barriers to deployment, including process changes, user adoption, governance, integration ownership, and operational readiness.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities within accounts, building on initial wins to drive long-term partnerships. This may include expanding deployments to additional workflows, sites, or robotic platforms.

Cross functional collaboration

  • Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral’s Research and Applied AI teams, synthesizing feedback to influence science focused product and research roadmaps.

  • Translate between customer business leaders, robotics specialists, software teams, operational teams, and Mistral’s technical experts.

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary projects involving AI models, robotics software, customer infrastructure, and external technology partners.

  • Create reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence. This includes reference approaches for robotics discovery, piloting, evaluation, and deployment.

  • Contribute to Mistral’s robotics GTM strategy by sharing market insights, customer needs, and deployment learnings.

  • Travel approximately 30 - 60% to foster deep client relationships and support onsite deployment.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years in a client facing strategic and technical role, for example deployment strategy, solutions architecture, value engineering, technical sales, or applied science, with hands on exposure to robotics or industrial automation.

  • Real depth in robotics, not just an interest. You can talk perception, planning, navigation, manipulation, control, simulation, and human-robot interaction, and you know where vision-language-action models fit and where they don't. You don't need to be a researcher, but you need to be credible with robotics engineers and with our VLA roadmap

  • Strong background in AI science domains (computer vision, robotics, embodied AI, etc.), you hold a degree in a scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Physics, Mathematics) - PhD is a plus. You are aware of recent model architectures in robotics, like VLM/VLA, you are able to understand where they fit. You don't need to be a researcher, but you need to be credible with robotics engineers and with our science roadmap.

  • Deep technical knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science with specialization in science domains, and the credibility to advise highly technical audiences

  • Experience shaping or delivering technology projects in physical or operational environments.

  • Comfortable working with robotics engineers and understanding integration constraints across hardware, software, data, and infrastructure.

  • Strong business acumen and structured problem solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value

  • Executive presence and strong communication skills with VP and C-level stakeholders on technically advanced solutions.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python).

  • Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment.

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and coordinating multidisciplinary teams across business, AI, software, robotics, and operations.

  • Experience with research-to-production transitions and working with research teams is a plus

Nice to have

  • Experience deploying robotics, industrial automation, computer vision, or edge-AI solutions.

  • Familiarity with robotics platforms, middleware, or simulation environments such as ROS, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or equivalent technologies.

  • Exposure to manufacturing, logistics, automotive, aerospace, energy, construction, or other robotics intensive industries.

  • Understanding of robotics data collection, evaluation, simulation, and sim-to-real considerations.

  • A track record taking a robotics or AI application from prototype to production.

  • Experience working with research, engineering, systems-integration, and industrial partner ecosystems.

  • Experience with hardware OEMs, integrators, or industrial procurement on the customer side.

     

Why This Role Matters

You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring that Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact.

Robotics is moving from narrowly programmed machines toward more adaptive systems powered by foundation models. Turning that potential into customer outcomes requires more than strong models: it requires clear use-case prioritization, thoughtful integration, realistic deployment plans, and close coordination between business, AI, robotics, and operational teams.

You will help customers navigate this transition, translating strategic ambition into production-ready robotics solutions while ensuring that Mistral’s technology addresses real operational needs.

title: Lead Technical Program Manager, AI Platform
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


🛠️ About our Program Management Team

Wayve’s Program Management team turns complex technical goals into coordinated delivery. Working closely with engineering, research and product teams, we align priorities, manage dependencies and bring clarity to ambiguous challenges. We combine technical depth with cross-functional leadership to help teams move faster, more effectively and with purpose—focusing on meaningful outcomes rather than process for its own sake.

As part of this team, you’ll build and lead the technical programme management function supporting our AI Platform organisation. AI Platform builds the data and compute infrastructure, model-development workflow tooling, training technology, compute management, and embedded and inference optimisation that enable Wayve’s models to be trained, iterated and deployed onto the vehicle.

The systems this organisation delivers determine how quickly Wayve can develop and ship models, how efficiently we use compute, and how well our models perform in training and on the vehicle.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Build, coach and support a small, high-impact TPM team, helping people develop their skills, work through challenges and raise the standard of programme delivery.

  • Act as a trusted delivery partner to AI Platform and Engineering leadership, aligning priorities, challenging trade-offs and holding teams accountable for meaningful outcomes.

  • Work across ML and research, infrastructure, embedded and on-vehicle engineering teams, as well as cloud and vendor partners, to manage dependencies, surface risks and remove blockers.

  • Use KPIs, dashboards and operational reviews to understand delivery progress, identify bottlenecks and steer decisions with the right data.

  • Represent AI Platform in company-level reviews, communicating progress, risks and decisions clearly while connecting delivery to business impact.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Building and scaling the technical programme management function for AI Platform, hiring to fill capability gaps and growing a high-performing team.

  • Owning planning, prioritisation and execution across the AI Platform roadmap in partnership with engineering leadership.

  • Leading flagship programmes across data and compute infrastructure, developer tooling, training technology, compute management, model-development workflows, and embedded and inference optimisation.

  • Establishing scalable planning cadences, governance, escalation paths and operational practices that bring structure without slowing delivery.

  • Driving measurable improvements in developer velocity, compute efficiency and cost, training and inference performance, and platform reliability.

  • Helping engineering leaders deliver high-leverage outcomes, balancing technical trade-offs and ensuring commitments translate into impact.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You bring 8+ years of hands-on technical programme management experience across platform, infrastructure, compute, ML infrastructure, developer tooling, training or inference systems. You have built or scaled a programme function, led people and processes, and get things done with ownership and a bias for action.

  • You build, coach and grow high-performing teams. You know how to develop people, hire to strengthen the team and raise the bar on technical programme management.

  • You have strong technical depth across ML infrastructure, compute and embedded systems. You can engage credibly with platform and systems engineers without being expected to write production code. Your experience includes:

    • A strong understanding of machine learning, GPUs, and training and inference for models from 500M to 20B+ parameters, including the compute and orchestration that support them.

    • Embedded or on-vehicle systems experience, including inference optimisation, deploying models to constrained edge compute, and hardware-software trade-offs.

    • Familiarity with compute management, ML platform tooling and model-development or experiment workflows, using technologies such as Kubernetes, Ray, Flyte, Docker, Azure and Python.

    • Proficiency with AI agents and coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude or Codex to accelerate execution.

  • You stay objective under pressure and adapt your approach in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. You bring structure and clarity without creating unnecessary process or slowing delivery.

  • You think in systems, understanding how the parts of a complex platform stack fit together and how changes in one area affect others.

  • You’re product-minded, focusing on the people your programmes serve, prioritising by impact and defining what good looks like—not just tracking activity.

  • You align and influence across ML and research, infrastructure, embedded and engineering teams without relying on formal authority.

  • You connect technical investment to measurable outcomes, including developer velocity, compute efficiency, cost and model performance, and communicate direction and progress clearly using the right metrics.

  • You’re open to feedback and continuously improve how you and your team work.

  • Ideally, you have worked with a large-scale ML or compute platform used by hundreds of engineers and researchers.

  • Experience with embedded or edge inference, on-device model optimisation, hardware-aware ML, autonomous vehicles, robotics or another large-scale ML and infrastructure environment would be valuable.

  • An engineering or computer science degree, or experience working as an engineer, would be a plus.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency Interviews (TPM process, Cross-functional; 1 hour 45 minutes total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Program Design, Leadership & Management; 1 hour 45 minutes total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (30 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

About the role

You’ll join an AI-native engineering team where AI is central to how we design, build and ship software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands software deeply, uses AI to build better software faster, and wants to help improve how the whole team works.

You will own projects from understanding the customer problem to shipping a solution and improving it in production. Working closely with engineering and product, you will help decide what we build, how we build it, and where to invest as the platform grows.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. Your focus will reflect your strengths and the team’s priorities, whether that means building product experiences, developing backend services, or solving challenges across the platform. We value engineers who bring depth in their area and curiosity beyond it.

What you’ll do

  • Own projects from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment and follow-up.

  • Work closely with product and other engineers to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions and turn complex requirements into clear, usable software.

  • Build and improve the interfaces, APIs and services that financial institutions rely on for their compliance operations.

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing delivery speed with reliability, security and maintainability.

  • Investigate production issues and improve performance, observability and resilience as the platform grows.

  • Raise the engineering bar through knowledge sharing and improvements to how we develop and ship software.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our platform as we build more AI-powered compliance capabilities.

About you

  • You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and maintaining software in production.

  • You understand software in depth. You bring strong fundamentals and depth in backend or full-stack development. You can reason about data, concurrency, performance and failure modes, and investigate unfamiliar systems beyond the surface.

  • AI coding agents are central to how you work. You use tools such as Codex or Claude Code extensively to explore, build, test and review software. You keep experimenting with ways to make yourself more effective.

  • You bring the judgment that makes AI-assisted development work. You frame problems clearly, provide useful context, challenge assumptions and verify the resulting behavior. You can explain why a solution works and take responsibility for what you ship.

  • You take ownership. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a practical plan, follow through on delivery and improve the result in production. You are comfortable learning new technologies and working beyond your usual area when a problem calls for it.

  • You care about the product as much as the implementation. You want to understand who you are building for, challenge requirements when needed and assess whether your work solves the original problem.

  • You value simple, well-designed solutions. You know when to move quickly and when reliability, security or long-term maintenance require more care.

  • You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating. You explain your technical choices, welcome constructive disagreement and share what you learn with your teammates.

  • You want to help shape an AI-native engineering team. You enjoy improving how software gets built, from reusable agent workflows to better testing and feedback loops, and turning your own discoveries into practices that make the whole team more effective.

Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech or compliance is a plus.

Our technology

Our main language is TypeScript. Our stack includes:

  • Frontend: React, Apollo GraphQL and Storybook.

  • Backend: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Infrastructure: AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Development and testing: Nx, GitLab CI, Playwright.

You do not need experience with every part of our stack. We care about your engineering judgment, your ability to learn and the quality of the software you build.

Why join us

  • Join a company with traction and room to shape its future. With 100+ financial institutions using Dotfile and a recent Series A, you’ll help define the next stage of the product and engineering team.

  • Help shape how an AI-native team works. Experiment with new approaches, improve your own workflow and turn what you learn into practices that make the whole team more effective.

  • Put your engineering depth to work. Solve demanding problems in automation, AI, data and reliability, building software that financial institutions depend on every day.

  • Have a direct say in what you build. Influence technical decisions, own projects through to production, and see how your work changes the customer experience.


Our hiring process

  1. CTO conversation — 30-60 minutes : Discuss your background, explore the role and how our engineering team works, and answer technical questions to assess your engineering knowledge and problem-solving approach.

  2. Case study — 60 minutes : Design the architecture of a project we provide, or present the architecture of a past project you led. Walk us through your reasoning, technical decisions and trade-offs.

  3. Raise the bar — 30 minutes: Meet someone from Product or Solutions Consulting to discuss how you collaborate across teams, understand customer needs and approach problems together.

  4. Founder discussion — 15-30 minutes: Meet our CEO to discuss Dotfile’s ambition, what motivates you and the contribution you could make.

title: Supply Chain Program Manager
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


Supply Chain Programme Manager

🛠️ About our Supply Chain Team

The Supply Chain Programme Manager is a critical cross-functional role responsible for owning end-to-end supply chain execution across assigned programmes and product builds at Wayve. This includes prototype development, new product introduction (NPI) and supporting fleet launches.

You’ll serve as the primary Supply Chain lead for your programmes, ensuring programme deliverables, supplier compliance and seamless coordination across Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing and external partners. You’ll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Planning, Sourcing, Logistics, Finance, Legal and Suppliers, while partnering closely with global upfitters and third-party integration partners across the US, UK and other regions to ensure vehicle and programme timelines are met.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll own end-to-end material readiness across assigned programmes, translating engineering requirements and demand into procurement plans and identifying supply risks early in the product lifecycle.

You’ll operate as the strategic liaison between hardware engineering and procurement, coordinating internal teams, suppliers, upfitters and integration partners to keep builds moving. This role combines strategic programme ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, hardware-driven environment.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Acting as the primary Supply Chain lead for assigned programmes and internal product builds, including prototypes, NPI and subassemblies.

  • Owning end-to-end material readiness to support programme milestones across R&D, Engineering, Operations and Manufacturing.

  • Collaborating with Engineering, Planning, Sourcing, Logistics, Finance and Suppliers to align supply chain activities with programme timelines.

  • Acting as the strategic liaison between hardware engineering and procurement teams, including managing demand aggregation.

  • Translating engineering BOMs and aggregated Technical Programme Manager demand into procurement plans.

  • Identifying long-lead items and critical-path components early in the product lifecycle.

  • Tracking material status throughout build phases and proactively escalating gaps and risks.

  • Serving as the primary programme manager for upfitter and partner relationships, ensuring alignment across stakeholders.

  • Driving upfitter and partner activities to ensure vehicles meet overall programme timelines and quality standards.

  • Proactively identifying and resolving issues affecting vehicle build readiness, coordinating between internal teams and external partners.

  • Maintaining clear communication cadences with upfitters and stakeholders, tracking milestones and escalating risks as needed.

  • Defining, tracking and reporting key supply chain performance metrics, including material availability, total cost savings and inventory cycle count accuracy.

  • Establishing programme-level supply chain dashboards and reporting cadences to provide leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with visibility.

  • Analysing KPI trends to identify root causes of supply chain underperformance and driving corrective actions with suppliers and internal teams.

  • Using KPI insights to continuously improve supply chain processes, reduce waste and increase overall programme efficiency.

  • Collaborating with Supply Chain Team Leads to ensure direct purchasing, indirect purchasing and logistics suppliers meet compliance requirements, including legal, environmental, regulatory requirements such as TISAX and ISO, and ethical sourcing standards.

  • Partnering with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate supplier agreements, NDAs and risk controls are in place.

  • Developing contingency plans for supply disruptions and actively managing supply chain risks.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have 10+ years of progressive experience in supply chain programme management, NPI and hardware operations.

  • You have a strong understanding of BOM management, material planning and procurement processes.

  • You have demonstrated experience managing cross-functional programmes across Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain.

  • You bring strong analytical, problem-solving and risk-management skills.

  • You have excellent communication and stakeholder-management capabilities.

  • You are able to travel internally as needed.

  • Experience in the automotive, consumer, hardware or robotics industries is preferred.

  • Familiarity with supplier compliance frameworks, including TISAX, ISO standards and ethical sourcing requirements, is preferred.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 – Locations & Flexible Working:

Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll serve as the primary employment law advisor for Airwallex’s UK and EMEA operations, helping the business navigate complex employment matters as it scales globally.

  • Advise People leaders and business stakeholders across the employee lifecycle, including hiring, performance management, terminations, compensation, investigations and employee relations.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Credit
description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi's Credit tribe is early and moving fast. We're building the infrastructure that will power lending products for millions of people who've historically been locked out of fair credit - immigrants, diaspora communities, and the financially underserved across our 21 operating markets. This is a ground-floor opportunity: the tribe is being built right now, and the systems you design today will be the foundation everything else sits on.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Credit tribe and own core backend services end-to-end. You'll be working primarily in Go, with some existing Java services in the mix - switching between them is not the blocker, deep engineering craft and an instinct for how credit products behave is. We move fast and we don't micromanage, which means you'll need to bring the domain awareness to make the right call before anyone has to tell you.

What you'll build and own

  • Design, build and operate high-reliability backend services that power LemFi's credit products, from loan origination and underwriting through to repayment and collections.

  • Make the right architectural calls independently - data residency, service boundaries, state-machine design for loan lifecycles - without needing to be told what a credit-safe system looks like.

  • Own your services in production: instrument them, monitor them, debug them, and hold the bar on reliability and correctness.

  • Work closely with product and compliance to translate credit-domain requirements into clean, testable, maintainable code.

  • Use AI coding tools actively to accelerate delivery and improve test coverage, while taking full ownership of the correctness of every line that ships.

  • Contribute to growing the tribe - as one of the earliest engineers you'll help set the engineering culture, review others' work, and raise the bar on how we build.

Your experience

  • Strong backend engineering in Go; Java experience is a plus given our existing services, but Go is the primary language.

  • Meaningful fintech experience - you understand how financial systems behave under load, under regulation, and under audit.

  • Exposure to credit products (lending, underwriting, repayment, collections) at any level - even adjacent - so you arrive with the right instincts, not just a willingness to learn them.

  • Solid grasp of distributed systems design: event-driven architecture, service boundaries, data consistency, and failure modes.

  • You care about correctness and data integrity as much as velocity - you've worked in environments where getting it wrong has real consequences for real people.

  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in an environment where the spec is never fully finished and the team is still being built.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience building credit decisioning, risk scoring, or loan management systems.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up where you helped establish engineering foundations from scratch.

  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance constraints specific to consumer credit (e.g. FCA, data protection requirements for credit data).


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.
